title: Noor and the Confession
author: Emrys Ishikawa
blurb: Dominic Villalobos, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
